name: billflow
description: Billflow: marketing site, tenant dashboard, and the Supabase/NestJS billing API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @billflow/types -w @billflow/gst -w @billflow/upi -w @billflow/host-resolution -w @billflow/storefront && npm run build -w @billflow/api && npm run openapi -w @billflow/api && npm run generate -w @billflow/api-client && npm run build -w @billflow/api-client && npm run build -w @billflow/web && npm run build -w @billflow/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @billflow/api && npm run lint -w @billflow/web && npm run lint -w @billflow/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w @billflow/api && npm run test -w @billflow/web && npm run test -w @billflow/dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,dash -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @billflow/api" "npm run dev -w @billflow/web" "npm run dev -w @billflow/dashboard"
